name: MonarchLinkedDocsPanel
title: LinkedDocsPanel
wrapsNative: MonarchSectionCard (androidx.compose.material3.Surface) with androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column rows; androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu with MonarchSearchBar for the doc picker; MonarchTag (androidx.compose.material3.FilterChip) for the Space filter
summary: The panel of docs and links attached to a record: rows that open, Space filter chips, unlink, link a doc from a searchable menu, and add an external link.
whenToUse: On a record's detail screen (a ticket, a task, a campaign) to show and manage the specs, runbooks, notes and web pages attached to it.
whenNotToUse: For uploaded files use MonarchUploadQueue and MonarchFileCard. For a single link preview use MonarchLinkCard. For a long, paged list of documents use a LazyColumn of rows.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable public fun MonarchLinkedDocsPanel(items: List<MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem>?, onOpen: (MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, readOnly: Boolean = false, errorMessage: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, notice: String? = null, docOptions: List<MonarchLinkedDocsPanelOption> = emptyList(), onLinkDoc: ((docId: String) -> Unit)? = null, onDocQueryChange: ((query: String) -> Unit)? = null, onCreateDoc: (() -> Unit)? = null, onAddLink: ((url: String, title: String) -> Unit)? = null, onUnlink: ((MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem) -> Unit)? = null, unlinkingId: String? = null, spaceFilter: Boolean = true, unlinkIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchLinkedDocsPanelLabels = MonarchLinkedDocsPanelLabels())

public class MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem(id: String, title: String, kind: MonarchLinkedDocsPanelKind = MonarchLinkedDocsPanelKind.Doc, url: String? = null, docId: String? = null, meta: String? = null, status: String? = null, spaceId: String? = null, spaceName: String? = null, fileName: String? = null, unlinkable: Boolean = true)
public enum class MonarchLinkedDocsPanelKind { Doc, Link }
public class MonarchLinkedDocsPanelOption(docId: String, label: String, description: String? = null)

public class MonarchLinkedDocsPanelLabels(title: String? = null, linkDoc: String? = null, addLink: String? = null, newDoc: String? = null, searchDocs: String? = null, noDocs: String? = null, empty: String? = null, emptyReadOnly: String? = null, loading: String? = null, filterBySpace: String? = null, all: String? = null, noSpace: String? = null, chip: ((space: String, count: Int) -> String)? = null, hiddenByFilter: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, showAll: String? = null, unlink: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, unlinkText: String? = null, open: String? = null, urlLabel: String? = null, urlInvalid: String? = null, titleLabel: String? = null, add: String? = null, cancel: String? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: What is linked to the record, or null while loading.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Called when a row is tapped. The app opens the doc or the address; the panel never navigates.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Without rows the error state replaces them; with rows the message shows under them.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows a retry button with errorMessage.

options.name: notice
options.description: Replaces the rows and the actions, for example when the person has no access to docs.

options.name: docOptions
options.description: The docs the Link doc menu offers; docs already linked are left out.

options.name: onLinkDoc
options.description: Links the chosen doc. Shows Link doc when there are docOptions or onDocQueryChange.

options.name: onDocQueryChange
options.description: Receives the menu's search text, to search on the server and update docOptions.

options.name: onCreateDoc
options.description: Adds New doc to the menu.

options.name: onAddLink
options.description: Adds an external link; shows Add link and its form. An empty title becomes the host name.

options.name: onUnlink
options.description: Unlinks a row; shows an unlink button on unlinkable rows.

options.name: unlinkingId
options.description: The row being unlinked: its button shows progress and the other unlink buttons are disabled.

options.name: spaceFilter
options.description: Shows Space filter chips when the rows span more than one Space.

options.name: unlinkIcon
options.description: The unlink button's icon. Without it the button shows "Unlink".

states.name: rows
states.description: A row per doc or link: a file type icon, the title, the meta or host name, a status badge and an unlink button.

states.name: filtered
states.description: With rows in more than one Space, chips (All, then each Space, No Space last) filter them, and "2 more in other Spaces." with Show all appears under the rows.

states.name: adding a link
states.description: An inline form with Link and Title (optional), Add and Cancel; an address that is not a full http or https address shows an error.

states.name: unlinking
states.description: The row's unlink button shows progress and the others are disabled.

states.name: empty
states.description: "Nothing linked yet. Link a spec, runbook or notes, or add a link to any page.", or "Nothing linked yet." when read-only.

states.name: loading
states.description: The section card's skeleton rows, named "Loading linked docs".

states.name: failed
states.description: Without rows the section card's error state with Retry; with rows an inline error with Try again.

states.name: notice
states.description: A muted message instead of the rows and the actions.

appearance: A MonarchSectionCard with the row count beside the title. Titles are strong body text, meta lines muted captions, statuses neutral subtle badges, and the Space chips MonarchTag in their selectable colors. Every color is a theme role, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: The web panel is built around Rook Dossier and an EntityPicker popover with async search; on Android the doc menu is a DropdownMenu with a MonarchSearchBar that filters docOptions, and server search goes through onDocQueryChange. The web handles promises from onLinkDoc, onAddLink and onUnlink to show progress and errors; Android hoists that state: unlinkingId shows progress and errorMessage the error. Rows are buttons that call onOpen instead of anchors; there is no "opens in a new tab". The web moves focus to the next row after an unlink; Android leaves focus to the framework. The Space filter is kept by the panel across configuration changes and is not reported to the app. The rows are a Column, not a LazyColumn, because a record has few links and the panel sits in a scrolling screen. There is no iOS type to match yet.
accessibility: The title is a heading, read with the row count.
Each row is one button read as its title, its meta or host name, and its status, with the action "Open"; its file type icon is hidden because the text says what it is.
The unlink button is a separate element named "Unlink" and the row's title, with a 48dp touch target.
The Space chips are a group named "Filter by Space"; each chip is selected or not, so the filter does not depend on color.
The add-link form's fields have labels, and an invalid address shows its error as text under the field.
Rows wrap at font scale 2.0 and follow the reading direction; the unlink button follows the row.
edgeCases: A Space filter for a Space that no longer has rows shows every row.
A link without meta shows its host name without "www.".
An address such as "example.com" or "javascript:…" is refused by the form.
With neither docOptions nor onDocQueryChange there is no Link doc button.
Docs already linked are left out of the menu by docId.

examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchLinkedDocsPanel(
    items = items,
    onOpen = { /* open it.url or the doc */ },
    docOptions = listOf(
        MonarchLinkedDocsPanelOption({{docOptions.0.value}}, {{docOptions.0.label}}, {{docOptions.0.description}}),
        MonarchLinkedDocsPanelOption({{docOptions.1.value}}, {{docOptions.1.label}}, {{docOptions.1.description}}),
        MonarchLinkedDocsPanelOption({{docOptions.2.value}}, {{docOptions.2.label}}, {{docOptions.2.description}}),
    ),
    onLinkDoc = { docId -> items = items + MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem(id = "l-$docId", title = docId, docId = docId) },
    onCreateDoc = {},
    onAddLink = { url, title -> items = items + MonarchLinkedDocsPanelItem(id = url, title = title, kind = MonarchLinkedDocsPanelKind.Link, url = url) },
    onUnlink = { item -> items = items - item },
    unlinkIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
    linkDocIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Document, contentDescription = null) },
    addLinkIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Link, contentDescription = null) },
)
